_comment: Second canonical persona. Designed so the question mix actively distinguishes smart memory from raw retrieval: multi-hop (combine facts from >=2 sessions), temporal-update (which of two conflicting values is current?), and absence (correctly returning empty when the fact was never stored).
name: Priya Sharma
description: Product manager, 31, originally from Pune, moved to Seattle two years ago. Used to stress memory consolidation across multiple sessions plus correctly handling change-over-time and absent facts.
facts: Lives in Seattle, WA. Previously lived in Pune, India until 2023.
Works as a senior PM at a B2B SaaS company called Lattice (note: fictitious for the benchmark — not the real Lattice).
Dog: a corgi named Biscuit, adopted 2024.
Originally drank only black tea; switched to oolong in early 2024 after a trip to Taiwan.
Climbing instructor at Stone Gardens on Saturday mornings since mid-2023.

messages.content: Hey, just settled into the new place in Seattle. Capitol Hill is fun but the rent is wild.
Yeah, big change from Pune. Two years already since I left.
Arjun loves it too — he's an engineer at a security startup, so plenty of meetups around here.
Took Biscuit, the corgi, to the dog park this morning. He still hates other dogs but at least tolerates Labradors.
Adopted him last spring. Best decision.
Coffee meeting at work with the new ICs. I'm a senior PM at Lattice — B2B SaaS. The product is performance management software.
Three years into PM now, after switching from data engineering.
Used to be a hardcore black tea drinker. Assam every morning.
Then I went to Taiwan in early 2024 and oolong absolutely changed my life. That's all I drink now in the morning.
Climbing today was rough. I've been teaching Saturday mornings at Stone Gardens since 2023 and the V4 problems still humble me.
It's the highlight of my week though — climbing instructor is the only role I'd never want to give up.
